headline: Helping a real estate business stay connected with buyers beyond the first inquiry.
shortDescription: I built a GoHighLevel buyer-engagement setup combining a sales pipeline, long-term nurturing for website leads, past-buyer follow-ups, referral prompts, and recurring customer messages. The goal was to give different groups of buyers a clearer, more consistent communication journey.
title: A buyer follow-up system built for relationships that last beyond the sale.
deck: Some buyers are ready to move now. Others need time. And the relationship doesn't have to end once a property is sold. I built a GHL system to support communication at each of those stages.
focus: Buyer nurture, CRM pipeline, email/SMS automation
challenge: The project called for a more organized way to track buyers and keep in touch with them, whether they had just opted in through the website or had bought previously. Instead of relying on one-off follow-ups, the setup needed distinct campaigns for different moments in the buyer relationship.
roleSummary: I configured the buyer-focused GHL components documented in the project.

buildSections.title: Sales pipeline
buildSections.body: A single buyer pipeline to track movement from lead toward customer.

buildSections.title: Long-term buyer nurturing
buildSections.body: A marketing campaign sequence for prospective buyers who opted in through the website.

buildSections.title: Previous-buyer follow-up
buildSections.body: A campaign for past buyers, including prompts that encourage referrals.

buildSections.title: Birthday and anniversary messages
buildSections.body: Recurring campaigns linked to those occasions.

howItWorks: The pipeline provides a place to track opportunities. Prospective buyers can enter a long-term nurture journey. Past buyers receive a different follow-up path, while recurring birthday, anniversary, and holiday messages help maintain contact over time. Those pieces serve different stages of the buyer relationship rather than treating every contact the same way.
outcomeStatement: The project documentation marks all five deliverables complete and includes pipeline, email-template, and automation screenshots with references to walkthroughs. This establishes documented system configuration; measured conversion, sending performance, and revenue results are not available.

headline: Bringing a real estate funnel and its follow-up workflows into one documented build.
shortDescription: I worked on a full HBW funnel and automation project in GoHighLevel. The implementation documentation shows multiple workflow configurations, with accompanying screenshots and project handoff material. Here's a closer look at the work and how it was organized.
title: A full GoHighLevel funnel and automation build for a real estate business.
deck: A funnel is only one part of the customer journey. The workflows behind it need to be configured and documented, too. This project brings those elements together in one implementation record.
challenge: The project called for automation and a funnel for an upcoming webinar. The implementation record organizes the follow-up around workshop registration, attendance, replay engagement, assessment scores, and strategy sessions.
roleSummary: My documented work covers the funnel-and-automation project and multiple GHL workflow configurations.

buildSections.title: Workshop registration & reminders
buildSections.body: The project documents a master registration-to-reminder workflow.

buildSections.title: Post-workshop attendee follow-up
buildSections.body: A separate master workflow covers follow-up for workshop attendees.

buildSections.title: Replay nurture
buildSections.body: The documentation groups no-show follow-up and replay viewers into a replay nurture sequence.

buildSections.title: Assessment-based nurturing
buildSections.body: Separate sections document a four-week medium-score nurture sequence and a six-month lower-score nurture sequence.

buildSections.title: Strategy-session sequence
buildSections.body: A booked strategy-session workflow is documented as its own sequence.

buildSections.title: Sync & handoff documentation
buildSections.body: The record includes Zapier workflows for synchronization to FUB, plus walkthrough-video and customer-journey mapping sections. Linked videos are not available in this public case study.
